priorityList: Use Dragonrage if the targets will survive at least 15 seconds.
Use Deep Breath on cooldown, especially if Strafing Run is not active, to apply Melt Armor and trigger hero talent effects.
Use Tip the Scales inside Dragonrage, preferably before casting Eternity Surge or Fire Breath.
Cast Eternity Surge at Rank 1 as your highest priority empowered spell in AoE.
Cast Fire Breath at Rank 1 to apply its damage-over-time effect and extend Dragonrage via Animosity.
Spend Essence on Pyre if Dragonrage is not imminent and you have 4 or more targets, or if you have 12+ stacks of Charged Blast.
Channel Disintegrate (triggering Mass Disintegrate) as your primary Essence spender to apply Bombardments to multiple targets.
When using Mass Disintegrate, target the enemy with the lowest remaining duration of the Bombardments debuff.
Use Azure Sweep as your primary filler to generate Essence and maintain the Azure Sweep buff.
Cast Living Flame when Leaping Flames is active, provided you have a Burnout proc or are not capped on Essence.
Use Azure Strike as a secondary filler when moving or when Azure Sweep is not optimal.
Use offensive trinkets and potions during Dragonrage, ideally when Rising Fury stacks are high.
Only use Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace to trigger Scarlet Adaptation damage if no other offensive GCD is high priority.
Avoid using empowered spells if Dragonrage is about to come off cooldown (within 6 seconds) to ensure they are available for the extension window.
Interrupt Disintegrate early if there are 8 or more targets and Volatility is talented to maximize splash damage.
